description: Congestion on inter-urban roads is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. Monthly release presenting average vehicle delay experienced on the slowest ten per cent of journeys on inter-urban roads in England. This publication has been cancelled due to operational reasons. Source agency: Transport Designation: National Statistics Language: English Alternative title: Congestion on inter-urban roads. Coverage: United Kingdom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
